items.title: Artistes en résidence 2027-2028
items.org: Casa de Velázquez / Académie de France à Madrid
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: not stated
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Higher artistic studies diploma or significant artistic practice. Open to any nationality. Age: must be of legal age (major). Language: good command of French required; dossier and interview in French. IELTS: not required. NET: not required.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Casa de Velázquez page. Open 19 Oct–27 Nov 2026. Housing and studio provided. Monthly stipend amount for 2027-28 not yet approved by board (previous year €3,600/month for housed artists). Application free.

items.title: Residency 2028
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: €65 excl. VAT (€78.65 incl. VAT) or free (waived for DAC list countries including Lower Middle Income)
Programme fee: €2,750 excl. VAT
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (rent deducted from stipend)
Living: covered (monthly stipend €1,500 after rent deduction; €2,000 working budget)
You pay in total: €2,815 + travel (approx., if no waiver)
items.eligibility: Open to artists, designers, curators, writers, architects and artistic researchers. Individuals, duos, collectives, candidates with children welcome. No formal degree required. Age: no limit. Language: English sufficient for communication (Dutch also used). IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Alumni of Rijksakademie or De Ateliers full-time not eligible.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed via official site and e-flux/FAQ. Application open 5 Oct–1 Dec 2026 23:59 CET. Private furnished studio apartment, labs, €1,500 monthly stipend (housing deducted), €2,000 annual working budget. Enrolment fee €2,750. Application fee waived for Lower Middle Income countries (India qualifies).

items.title: Snowball Art Award 2026
items.org: Ann Wolff Foundation Gotland / Kosta Boda
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: 0
items.eligibility: Professional artists worldwide, wholly or partly supported by artistic practice. All disciplines; previous glass experience not required. Primarily supports female artists from Nordic region and internationally. Age: not stated. Language: English. IELTS: not required. NET: not required.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on e-flux announcement from Ann Wolff Foundation. Deadline 26 Nov 2026. Unrestricted grant SEK 200,000 + fully funded 5-day residency and travel/accommodation to Kosta Boda and award ceremony in Visby. Apply by PDF email to snowballartaward@awfg.se.

items.title: Yaddo Residency (Winter Application Cycle)
items.funding:
Fund: application fee only
Application fee: $40
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: $40 + travel
items.eligibility: Professional creative artists from all nations and backgrounds in visual art (painting, sculpture, printmaking, photography, mixed media, installation), literature, music composition, performance, film & video. Not enrolled in graduate or undergraduate degree programs. Age: not stated. Language: working knowledge of English helpful (no interpreters provided). IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Apply once every other calendar year.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Yaddo apply page. Winter cycle portal open 20 Nov, deadline 20 Dec 2026 23:59 EST (or 1,600 apps). Room, board, studio provided. Access grants available for travel. No residency fee.

items.title: Artist Residency Grants 2028
items.org: Helene Wurlitzer Foundation of New Mexico
items.funding:
Fund: application fee only
Application fee: $30
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered
Living: you pay
You pay in total: $30 + $300 deposit (half refundable) + food + travel
items.eligibility: Visual artists (painters, sculptors, photographers, etc.), literary artists, music composers from any nationality. Age: not stated. Language: English (application in English). IELTS: not required. NET: not required. No imposed work requirements during stay.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official foundation apply page. Open for 2028 sessions (Jan-Apr, Jun-Aug, Sep-Dec). Rent-free fully furnished casita and utilities. Residents pay own food and transportation. $300 deposit on selection (half retained).

items.location: Various US cities (Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York, New Orleans, San Francisco, Washington D.C. or other)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered
Stay: covered
Living: covered (daily stipend ~$110 in Washington D.C. example)
You pay in total: 0
items.eligibility: Creators, thinkers, cultural professionals with original research project requiring US immersion. Any nationality if supported by French partner based in France. Age: 21+ before departure. Language: working proficiency in English (3-min video required). IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Professional experience required. Individual preferred (duos possible).
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Villa Albertine page. Applications open to 21 Jan 2027 23:59 Paris time. Exploratory 1-3 month residencies. Covers international travel, accommodation, daily living stipend, insurance. Requires French partner letter of support. Not production residency.
